# documents

Filing retrieval, guarded answers and classification.

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| [chunking.py](chunking.py) | Chunking (Blueprint §4.5, §8 micro-detail). |
| [crossencoder.py](crossencoder.py) | Trained cross-encoder rerankers (Blueprint §4.6) behind the same scorer interface as ``rerank.ollama_scorer``. |
| [digest.py](digest.py) | Deterministic evidence digest: an answer composed ONLY of what the retrieved announcements state (dates, categories, quoted text), used when the LLM refuses although the reranker rates the evidence highly relevant. |
| [embeddings.py](embeddings.py) | Dense embeddings via a local Ollama server (Blueprint §30 local deployment). |
| [eval.py](eval.py) | Retrieval evaluation (Blueprint §4.10, §27). |
| [event_classifier.py](event_classifier.py) | Announcement event-type classifier (13 classes: NSE categories grouped; results + board-meeting outcomes merged because NSE moved results filings between those two categories in 2025). |
| [evidence.py](evidence.py) | Evidence packs: the contract between retrieval and generation (Blueprint §4.6, §14). |
| [extraction.py](extraction.py) | Structured extraction: turning documents into features (Blueprint §4.7). |
| [guardrails.py](guardrails.py) | Hallucination control (Blueprint §4.9, §23). |
| [index.py](index.py) | Persistent, incremental, point-in-time vector index (closes Known Simplification #23: ``hybrid_retrieve`` re-embedded its whole eligible pool on every call, impossible at corpus scale). |
| [ingest.py](ingest.py) | NSE corporate announcements ingestion (Blueprint §4.3, §4.5). |
| [judge.py](judge.py) | Content-based relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation (replaces metadata-derived relevance). |
| [llm.py](llm.py) | LLM explanation layer via a local Ollama model (Blueprint §4.9, §11 of v2). |
| [nli.py](nli.py) | Pretrained natural-language-inference faithfulness check (MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli, safetensors, runs locally). |
| [rerank.py](rerank.py) | Second-stage reranker (Blueprint §4.6 "learned reranker"): a local LLM judges each fused candidate's relevance to the query pointwise (0-10, temperature 0), and the final score blends that judgement with the first-stage RRF score. |
| [retrieval.py](retrieval.py) | Hybrid retrieval with a point-in-time firewall (Blueprint §4.4, §10). |
| [schemas.py](schemas.py) | Point-in-time document contract (Blueprint §4.3, §4.4). |
